result: The deterministic static one-handoff gate is source-present on main and passed repository-hosted CI at PR head and merged-main scope. It reuses release_integrity rather than minting a second payload authority, binds the exact prehandoff receipt reference to the verified manifest, validates the installer route graph, and remains fail-closed on tamper or route-law mismatch.
evidence_boundary: This reconciliation does not establish that a final release ZIP was built, that an external pre-handoff receipt exists, that any installer ran, that any clean machine or VPS was mutated, or that target/runtime/physical/effect/completion/whole-system acceptance occurred.
next_exact_action: Produce or identify one exact final deterministic release ZIP with a stable external prehandoff receipt reference bound in its manifest; run the accepted static gate on the extracted exact artifact to create that external receipt; then admit only real clean-machine observations carrying the same manifest hash + receipt ref through clean_machine_acceptance.py.
